en-US.content: Designed for zero-defect electronics manufacturing, the OptiScan Pro X1 combines multi-phase structured light projection with telecentric optics to eliminate shadow blind spots on dense assemblies.
en-US.seo_title: OptiScan Pro X1 Inline 3D AOI System | PrecisionTech

en-US.seo_description: Zero-cogging linear motor positioning stage engineered for wafer metrology, photonics alignment, and laser processing.

en-US.title: How to Select an Inline 3D AOI System for Automotive PCBA Lines
en-US.author: Application Engineering Team
en-US.summary: Key optical, cycle-time, and MES traceability criteria when evaluating 3D inspection equipment for automotive electronics.
en-US.short_answer: When selecting an inline 3D AOI for automotive PCBA, prioritize dual/quad-projector shadow suppression, Gage R&R under 10%, and native IPC-CFX traceability.
en-US.content: Automotive electronics demand strict solder joint volume measurement and pin-in-paste inspection without slowing line takt time. Evaluating projector geometry, telecentric lens distortion, and false-call tuning workflows upfront reduces commissioning time by over 40%.
en-US.seo_title: Selecting Inline 3D AOI for Automotive PCBA | Technical Guide
en-US.seo_description: Engineering checklist covering optical resolution, shadow suppression, Gage R&R, and IPC-CFX integration for automotive SMT lines.

zh-CN.title: 汽车电子 PCBA 产线如何科学选型在线 3D AOI 设备
zh-CN.author: 应用工程团队
zh-CN.summary: 从多向投影消影、节拍匹配、Gage R&R 重复性及 MES 追溯协议四个维度拆解选型指标。
zh-CN.short_answer: 汽车电子 PCBA 选型在线 3D AOI 时，核心应核验多向结构光消影能力、小于 10% 的 Gage R&R 指标以及原生 IPC-CFX 追溯对接能力。
zh-CN.content: 车规级电子装联对焊锡体积测量与通孔回流焊检测提出了极高要求。提前评估远心镜头畸变率、高元件阴影抑制算法及换线编程效率，可将产线导入调试周期缩短 40% 以上。
zh-CN.seo_title: 汽车电子在线 3D AOI 选型技术指南 | 精工智测
zh-CN.seo_description: 详解车规级 SMT 产线 3D AOI 光学分辨率、阴影抑制、Gage R&R 与智能工厂协议选型标准。

en-US.question: Can systems be customized for non-standard substrate sizes and cleanroom environments?
en-US.answer: Yes. Both optical gantry spans and motion stage stroke lengths can be tailored to custom carrier dimensions, with ISO Class 5 cleanroom-compatible cabling and materials available.

en-US.question: How is sample evaluation conducted before placing an OEM order?
en-US.answer: Send sample assemblies or CAD drawings to our application lab. Within 48 hours of receipt, we provide a full repeatability report, cycle-time simulation, and imaging dataset.

zh-CN.question: 设备是否支持非标载具尺寸定制与无尘洁净室环境改造？
zh-CN.answer: 支持。光学龙门跨距与直线平台行程均可按客户载具图纸定制，并可选配符合 ISO Class 5 标准的低发尘拖链与密封材料。

zh-CN.question: 在正式采购或 OEM 合作前，如何进行样品实测评估？
zh-CN.answer: 您可将测试样品或 CAD 图纸寄送至我们的应用实验室，收到样品后 48 小时内即可出具完整的检测重复性报告、节拍测算与实拍图像集。
